title: We Will Glorify
lyrics_original: We will glorify the King of Kings,
We will glorify the Lord of Lords,
Who is the great I AM!
We will bow before His throne!
We will worship Him in righteousness,
He is Lord of heaven, Lord of earth,
He is Lord of all who live!
He is Lord above the universe,
All praise to Him we give!
Hallelujah to the King of Kings,
Hallelujah to the Lord of Lords
Who is the great I AM!

bible_verses.english: He has on his garment and on his thigh a name written, "KING OF KINGS, AND LORD OF LORDS."
God said to Moses, "I AM WHO I AM," and he said, "You shall tell the children of Israel this: 'I AM has sent me to you.'"
Worship Yahweh in holy array. Tremble before him, all the earth.

devotional.prayer_english: Lord God, You are the King of Kings, the sacrificial Lamb, and the great I AM who reigns above all things. Today, I bow my heart before Your holy throne in awe of Your majestic power and tender love. Teach me to worship You alone, placing You at the very center of my life and decisions. May my entire life glorify Your name in every word and action. Amen.

devotional.reflection_english: "We Will Glorify" lifts our eyes to the supreme authority and sacrificial love of Jesus, our King and the Lamb of God. When we proclaim His identity as the great "I AM," we align our hearts with the heavenly throne where He reigns in perfect majesty. This song invites us to step out of our daily worries and offer Him our undivided praise. As we bow before Him, we find true peace in worshipping the only One who is truly worthy of our whole lives.
